facts.value: Contact the writing internship coordinator, make an appointment to discuss the internship, and bring a recent copy of your resume.
With approval, you will sign up for ENG 484.
Send a professional e-mail/phone call to the contact person at the internship sponsoring organization to set up an initial meeting.
English 484 is a support course for the internship experience, where students reflect on their learning.
The course involves sharing internship experiences, analyzing the workplace environment, and receiving feedback on work-related projects.
Very few internships offer monetary compensation; the vast majority are unpaid.
